input.text: Your approach of starting with a total of 0 and adding each number is right, but think about which numbers your loop actually visits. To get the full sum, the loop must include the very first number as well as the rest; leaving out one end of the list means every sum will be missing that value.

content.text: The failure pattern confirms it: every output is exactly the sum without the first number (for example `1 2 3` gives `5` instead of `6`, and a single number gives `0`). The hint above nudges toward why that happens.
